rules.tags: all ASSUMED design rules carried over from Stage 12 or stated here

diamond.src: rho, eps: Stage 12 (CITED Bose/van de Kamp); theta_D 2200 K: Stage 13; tan(delta)=1e-5 window-grade CVD: Stage 13 (Garin et al.; Diamond Materials spec)

lead.src: rho 11340 kg/m3, Tc 7.2 K: standard handbook; theta_D 105 K: Van Sciver, Helium Cryogenics, Table 2.1 (https://www.jlab.org/sites/default/files/magnet-group/materials/low_temperature_materials_properties.pdf); Hofer 2023 used 90/10 PbSn, rho 10900

niobium.src: rho 8570, Tc 9.2 K: Pino et al. QST 3, 025001 (2018) App. A; theta_D 275 K: Van Sciver Table 2.1

silica.src: rho 2200 and eps 3.8: standard fused-silica values (ASSUMED as such); theta_D ~470 K ASSUMED; tan(delta)=1e-3 ASSUMED

osmium.src: rho 22590: Krisnanda et al. npj QI 6, 12 (2020) (arXiv:1906.08808); theta_D ~500 K ASSUMED; Im chi 1e-3 ASSUMED

soa.label: Pedalino 2025 cluster interference
soa.src: Stage 12 ledger: 172 kDa, 133 nm grating, ~10 ms flight

soa.label: Rossi 2025 delocalised nanosphere
soa.src: Rossi et al., PRL (2025), arXiv:2408.01264: 1.2 fg silica, coherence length 73+-34 pm (x3.5 of 21 pm); t = 2 x pi/(2 Omega_e) + pi/(2 Omega_m) with 18 us period, r = 2.45 -> 26 us (DERIVED)

soa.label: Bild 2023 16 ug HBAR cat (internal mode)
soa.src: Bild et al., Science 380, 274 (2023), arXiv:2211.00449: M_eff 16.2 ug, delocalised over 2.1e-18 m; ~80 us (Physics Today 2023). NOT a centre-of-mass displacement

lpf.src: LISA Pathfinder differential acceleration noise 1.74 fm s^-2/sqrt(Hz) above 2 mHz, Armano et al. PRL 120, 061101 (2018), https://sci.esa.int/web/lisa-pathfinder/-/59964-armano-et-al (2 kg masses, space, mHz band)

diamond_spin.label: (a) diamond + NV spin, diamagnetic trap, plate
diamond_spin.env_src: T_env=T_int=1 K, T_gas=4 K, P=1e-15 Pa: Stage 12 defaults (QGEM-design XHV)
